about_the_game:
Bellum Inferni is a brutal descent into the pits of Hell, where you carve your way to power as a ruthless warlord. The last prince of hell has fallen into an eternal slumber, and in the power vacuum that followed, a struggle for control has begun. As Savnok, a demon lord favored of Lucifer, you will rampage throughout the damned realms, gathering an infernal force in a bid to bring Hell’s eternal conflict to Heaven’s doorstep.

This is the ultimate power fantasy of being an unstoppable force, mowing down thousands of enemies in a way previously unmatched in the FPS genre. Bellum Inferni revolutionizes the player experience by fusing high-intensity, push-forward action FPS combat with expansive battlefield warfare. You will command legions of damned souls, unleash hellish powers, and summon monstrous beasts to crush your foes in a blaze of violence.

COMMAND THE LEGIONS OF HELL

  • Command your demonic horde, rallying massive behemoths and hellish demons to your banner.

  • The army command system is intentionally lightweight to provide tactical depth without overwhelming hardcore FPS fans.

  • Issue orders to advance, defend, or rally through a simple HUD or a dedicated menu, without breaking the moment-to-moment action.

  • All interactions with your army directly loop back into the FPS experience, allowing you to send them to handle objectives or lower the heat from enemies.

WAGE WAR ON AN EPIC SCALE

  • Engage in massive battles against armies featuring thousands of units and gigantic beasts.

  • Lay siege to immense citadels in adrenaline-fueled, chaotic clashes and awe-inspiring encounters.

  • Journey across a grand narrative campaign that guides you through the diverse Infernal Landscape, encompassing a variety of biomes beyond typical fire and brimstone.

  • Battlefields are not open-world, but feature large, curated “bubbles” where you can fight enemies with surprising combinations of movement and abilities.

MASTER BRUTAL, HIGH-SPEED COMBAT

  • Combat is fast-paced, and constant movement is the only way to survive.

  • Wield an arsenal where every weapon has two offensive modes: one for single targets and another for dealing with multiple enemies at once.

  • Dominate your enemies with a combination of medium to long-range gunplay and powerful area-of-effect abilities. Melee strikes are situational tools that never slow your momentum.

  • Utilize innovative movement mechanics—including surface running, grappling, and dashing—that create a high skill ceiling and enable true player mastery.

ASCEND TO THE THRONE

  • Begin your journey with nothing and rise to become the most powerful being in all the Infernal Realms.

  • As you grow in strength, so does the strength of your army. Progression is punctuated by unlocking new squad types and specialties.

  • Acquire powerful new abilities and augment them with currencies accrued through play.

  • Upgrade your weapons down two distinct enhancement paths to refine your grim arsenal.

MANAGE THE AMBITIONS OF DEMONS

  • Engage with a lightweight management system where the Officers and Heroes in your army possess their own desires and ambitions.

  • If their ambitions are not managed, your commanders are more likely to mutiny on the battlefield.

  • A mutiny presents a unique challenge, but pacifying the rebels offers a significant and unique reward, making it a sometimes-desired event players can strategize around.

Only the most savage will survive this war to dominate Hell's War.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains violent and intense action, gore, violence in combat and world settings/themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics Card (GPU): NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: Become the unstoppable, destructive force at the center of Hell's eternal war. Fight in massive battles against thousands of demons that stretch to the horizon. Master brutal, high-speed combat and seamlessly command your own legions to carve a bloody path to the throne of Hell.
